question: What is your refund policy?
expected_answer: Customers can request a refund within 30 days.

question: How can I reset my password?
expected_answer: Use the password reset option on the login page.

question: How long does shipping take?
expected_answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days.

question: How can I contact customer support?
expected_answer: Customers can contact support through email or live chat.

question: Can I cancel my order?
expected_answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
expected_answer: International shipping is available for selected countries.

question: How can I track my order?
expected_answer: Use the tracking number provided in the shipping confirmation email.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
expected_answer: Major credit cards and supported online payment methods are accepted.

question: Can I change my shipping address?
expected_answer: The shipping address can be changed before the order is shipped.

question: What should I do if my order arrives damaged?
expected_answer: Contact customer support and provide photos of the damaged package.

question: Do you provide order confirmation?
expected_answer: A confirmation email is sent after an order is successfully placed.

question: How do I create an account?
expected_answer: Click the sign-up option and provide the required account information.

question: Can I update my account information?
expected_answer: Account information can be updated from the account settings page.

question: What happens if I forget my password?
expected_answer: Use the password reset option to create a new password.

question: Do you charge for returns?
expected_answer: Return shipping fees depend on the reason for the return and the applicable policy.

question: When will I receive my refund?
expected_answer: Refunds are generally processed after the returned item is received and approved.

question: Can I exchange an item?
expected_answer: Eligible items can be exchanged according to the exchange policy.

question: What are your business hours?
expected_answer: Customer support is available during normal business hours.

question: How do I report a billing issue?
expected_answer: Contact customer support with your order and billing details.

question: Can I place an order without creating an account?
expected_answer: Guest checkout may be available depending on the service configuration.

question: Is my payment information secure?
expected_answer: Payment information is handled using secure payment processing systems.

question: How do I update my email address?
expected_answer: Update your email address from the account settings page.

question: Can I use a discount code?
expected_answer: Enter a valid discount code during checkout to apply the discount.

question: Why has my order been delayed?
expected_answer: Orders may be delayed because of shipping, processing, or unexpected operational issues.

question: How do I know if my order has shipped?
expected_answer: A shipping confirmation message with tracking information is sent when the order ships.

question: Can I return an item after 30 days?
expected_answer: Returns after 30 days depend on the applicable return policy and exceptions.

question: What if I received the wrong item?
expected_answer: Contact customer support and provide your order details so the issue can be resolved.

question: Can I have multiple accounts?
expected_answer: Multiple accounts may be allowed depending on the applicable account policy.

question: How can I delete my account?
expected_answer: Account deletion can be requested through account settings or customer support.

question: Where can I find my order history?
expected_answer: Order history is available in the account section after signing in.
